name: project-structure
description: Ports the current Pi project-structure cadence, ignore rules, depth config, and project_tree tool to Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Inject Pi-compatible project trees and inspect directories
interface.longDescription: Injects a bounded project tree at session start, after compaction, and every ten prompts using Pi-compatible project-structure.ignore and pj-tree.conf semantics; also provides a read-only project_tree MCP tool.
